race.comment: MASHEAN (5) is desperate to strike again after narrowly missing in a CL2 at Grafton after being tightened and racing keenly last time. She was respected in an open market there. Has good early speed and only needs to hold her form to be fighting out the finish again. SUN SISTER (9) is the main danger on her Sunshine Coast second two back, where she had MASHEAN and SUPER LUCK DRAGON behind her. Worth forgiving last start when tackling Saturday company at Eagle Farm, she was clearly below her best. SUPER LUCK DRAGON (3) has had excuses at his past two, including a slow start and being checked at Lismore after racing wide at the Sunshine Coast. Is back to a winning trip and can't be underestimated. DECADAD (4) resumes after a string of seconds before the break. Owns a win and a placing from two starts at this venue and gets in well at the weights with the 3kg claimer engaged. Not dismissing.
